name: Trattoria Zappatori
dinnerNote: Six-course tasting menu, Menù 1975 or Materie prime (four courses €110)
lunchNote: Colazione di lavoro working lunch · Fridays (tasting menus from €110 at lunch Fri–Sun)
lunchNoteIt: Colazione di lavoro · venerdì (menu degustazione da €110 a pranzo ven–dom)

menus.name: six-course Menù 1975 tasting menu
menus.note: Five savoury dishes and a dessert from the traditional Menù 1975, the same for the whole table; lunch or dinner; local wine pairing €70, or €90 with wines from Italy and abroad

menus.name: six-course Materie prime tasting menu
menus.note: Two chosen ingredients (such as mushrooms or roots) developed into five savoury dishes and a dessert, the same for the whole table; lunch or dinner; local wine pairing €70, or €90 with wines from Italy and abroad

menus.name: four-course tasting menu
menus.note: Three savoury dishes and a dessert from either the Menù 1975 or the Materie prime menu, the same for the whole table; lunch or dinner; local wine pairing €50, or €70 with wines from Italy and abroad

menus.name: Colazione di lavoro working lunch
menus.note: Friday lunch only, not on public holidays; snacks, two dishes from the Menù 1975 (some €10 extra), petits fours, coffee and water, the same for the whole table

bookingOpens: Online with the booking form on the restaurant's website, by phone or by email (info@trattoriazappatori.it).
groups: The booking form offers a chef's table for up to two people and a small private room for up to four.
